description.blurb: Euclid is a European Space Agency mission to map the geometry of the Universe and better understand dark matter and dark energy, which make up most of the energy budget of the cosmos.
description.more: Euclid will probe the history of the expansion of the Universe and the formation of cosmic structures by measuring the redshift of galaxies out to a value of 2, which is equivalent to seeing back 10 billion years into the past. In this way, Euclid will cover the entire period over which dark energy played a significant role in accelerating the expansion of the Universe.
